displaySummary.zh: AI100（2022-2023）· 语言模型蛋白质折叠

displayDescription.en:
ESMFold predicts atomic-level protein structures directly from a single amino-acid sequence using representations learned by the ESM-2 protein language model. It avoids the multiple-sequence-alignment search used by many earlier high-accuracy pipelines, enabling much faster inference across very large sequence collections.

The accompanying work used this speed to explore hundreds of millions of metagenomic protein sequences and release the ESM Metagenomic Atlas.
displayDescription.zh:
ESMFold 使用 ESM-2 蛋白质语言模型学到的表示，直接从单条氨基酸序列预测原子级蛋白质结构。它不依赖许多早期高精度流程使用的多序列比对搜索，因此能够更快地处理超大规模序列集合。

相关工作利用这种速度探索数亿条宏基因组蛋白质序列，并发布 ESM Metagenomic Atlas。

html.en: High-accuracy protein structure prediction had made a major leap, but many pipelines still depended on computationally expensive searches for evolutionary relatives. ESMFold explored whether a large protein language model could internalize enough evolutionary information to predict structure directly from one sequence.
html.zh: 高精度蛋白质结构预测已经取得重大突破，但许多流程仍依赖计算昂贵的进化同源序列搜索。ESMFold 探索大型蛋白质语言模型能否内化足够的进化信息，从单条序列直接预测结构。

html.en: ESM-2 learns contextual representations from large protein sequence databases, and a folding trunk converts those representations into three-dimensional coordinates and confidence estimates. Removing the multiple-sequence-alignment stage trades some peak accuracy for dramatically higher throughput and a simpler single-sequence workflow.
html.zh: ESM-2 从大型蛋白质序列数据库学习上下文表示，折叠主干再把这些表示转换为三维坐标与置信度估计。移除多序列比对阶段，以部分峰值精度换取大幅提高的吞吐量和更简洁的单序列流程。

html.en: Experts generally treat ESMFold as strong evidence that protein language models learn structural information at useful biological scale. Its lasting contribution is not only a fast predictor but also a demonstration that language-model representations can support massive structure atlases and downstream protein analysis.
html.zh: 专家通常把 ESMFold 视为有力证据：蛋白质语言模型能够在有用的生物学尺度上学到结构信息。它的长期贡献不仅是快速预测器，还证明语言模型表示可以支撑超大规模结构图谱与下游蛋白质分析。
